# PhotoGallery

> **Partial assessment:** core cloud-readiness and .NET 10 upgrade analysis were blocked by missing `Microsoft.WebApplication.targets` on this Linux runner. Compatibility remains unknown; rerun both analyses on a Windows runner with the legacy ASP.NET build tools and .NET Framework 4.8 targeting pack.
>
> Security results include **16 CVEs** at medium or higher and **8 CWE checklist matches** across 59 rules. Dependency coverage is limited to the pinned inventory; full transitive enumeration was blocked. Related CWE rules can describe the same root cause. See the [security report](security/security-assessment.md) for evidence, remediation recommendations, and coverage limitations, and the [upgrade assessment](scenarios/dotnet-version-upgrade/assessment.md) for the recorded failure.
